reviews.text: My partner and I recently adopted my partners recently deceased grandmothers elderly cat. We knew that she had started to have some issues with hair balls and decided to get her hair cut. We absolutely loved the experience we had here! Not only was the customer service excellent, the entire process was smooth and easy. She took great care of Mingus and she looks phenomenal!! We can’t wait to go back
Awesome! Have everything and coils. Yay. Love hash too. Mmmmmm lllooovvveee BB. G
Alexis always does a great job with my Himalayan, he’s so handsome with his lion cut! She’s quick, efficient, and affordable. I’ve been coming here around 4 years now. Highly recommend!
A good friend of my daughter suggested this place and I could not have been happier. My Yorkie, Milton, is 13 and she made him feel comfortable and did a great job grooming him.  We will be back!

I was making a turn onto Morris from 17th Street. The door to this business was open. There were two dogs with leashes on but no one was holding the leashes. One dog ran into the street as I was about to turn. A lady took hold of the lease of the dog that ran into the street but no one went to secure the other dog. Is this how you conduct business with people's pets?

My first time ever taking my cat Scarlet to a groomer. I was super nervous and I had to work and couldn't be there for the drop off. Regardless I am extremely satisfied. Her fur was matting and bringing her here was the best thing I could have done. She treated my cat as if she were her own and went above and beyond for me and Scarlet knowing this was our first time. I am truly grateful!

Alexis was extremely professional, prompt, and flexible. The hygienic trim for my longhair cat was reasonably priced and expertly done. We will definitely be returning and I would recommend Pets and the City to everyone especially if you’re in South Philly.

The I had the pleasure of using pets and the city. The service here was amazing. The owner clearly loves animals. I watch pet owners drop off and the dogs were so happy to see her. I’m a cat owner she greeted my sweet girl with kind words and rubs. I will def be going back.  Also my fur baby smells amazing.

My dog tends to be scared when I take her to the groomers because of the loud noises but she instantly took to Alexis and still loved her when I went to pick her up! Alexis did an awesome job on the groom and her prices are super fair!
Cute local business and fair prices. Alexis was very patient, kind, and fast.

Could not be happier with the experience! I was nervous as it was my cat’s first grooming experience, but Alexis did great and my cat left looking and smelling so clean! The pricing was very fair compared to other cat grooming services in the city. Scheduling was easy and communicative leading up to appointment. Would bring my cat back in a heartbeat!!!

I recently been looking around for a groomer for
My cat Mr T. I’m really particular to who groom my pet. Because I had a really really bad experience before. Pet and the city is amazing! Clean groom and super friendly. Mr. T lion cut is flawless and treat my cat with gentle care. I’m definitely their new regular from now on. I highly recommend pet and the city.

I have been taking my labradoodle here for a couple years and she loves going to this groomer, Alexis .  She treats Riley like her own and she leaves there looking beautiful and happy. I would recommend her to anyone, Riley loves Alexis I don't think she would want to go anywhere else she so used to her now been going here for about 5 yrs. Thank u Pets and the City ❤️🐾
Alexis is caring and so wonderful with my cat! I highly recommend!
Alexis was great, communicated when my dog was done and was FAST!!!
Jeter has been coming here for 10 years Lexi  is the best she is so patient with him even when he hates his nails clipped, and her prices are great. ❤️

Alexis is a real human being who really cares about our furry friends. She took in my big boy, Benny the cat, and really helped him with his tangled and matted fur. He has been so healthy and energetic since. I’m so grateful, that I’m going to take my JoJo (tuxedo cat)  in to see Alexis, and also my Frenchie, Milo. She’s the best!!!
We had a fantastic experience at Pets and the City! My dog can be a bit tricky with nail trims, but Alexis made it super easy and let me stay with him to keep him comfortable
Great shop with great people! Check them out!
Our cat needed a sanitary trim and basic groom, and Alexis did a great job! The whole thing took about an hour and was very reasonably priced. Would highly recommend!

Alexis did a wonderful job with my cat, Miesu. She asked what Miesu’s comfort levels were and was upfront about her services. I dropped him off at 1:00 and picked him up around 3:30 so she was timely as well. The pricing was very fair, and my cat had a lot of fur! My Miesu looks like a gentleman now! She even gave him a cute necktie. Happy to say I’ve found a new groomer for my cat.

Alexis is amazing!! Literally the best. My cat went to her today for a shave and bath. Alexis was so good with her. Chloe looks amazing and smells so clean and fresh. Beautiful and clean shop with the cutest little clothes for the dogs and cats. They also have a treat table with cookies and cannoli's for the fur babies. Will definitely be taking Chloe back!!!!

Alexis did a fantastic job with my dog! She was wonderful with my shy dog, who usually hates going to the groomer. The trim and bath were exactly what I wanted, and the prices are very reasonable for such exceptional service. Pets and the City will definitely be our go-to pet groomer from now on.

Alexis is truly the best. I was so worried today when I took my 16 year old to be groomed. Alexis did such a beautiful job with her. I highly recommend this shop for grooming your animals. Alexis has so much patience and loves all the animals. I rate this ship 10 out of 10.

I have taken my cat Marlowe to Alexis for almost five years now, and she is the best cat groomer! I highly recommend that, if you have any pet needs, you talk to Alexis. She even takes care of Marlowe when I need someone to drop by and feed her for a few days. Alexis is absolutely incomparable!

Alexis did a super,awesome job on my cat Dusty, I was so happy when i picked her up, and seen how beautiful she looked. If anyone
needs their cat or dog done, i suggest you contact Alexis, at 1649 south 17th Sts, you will not be disappointed.

Alexis is amazing. I have a havanese poodle mix, and she has very fine curly hair that gets easily matted at the base. Alexis always does a great job despite the difficulties. Her prices are very reasonable as well. I wouldn't go anywhere else in the city.

Our newly rescued pup, Georgie, was in rough shape after being found on the streets...
Alexis previously groomed our dearly departed Rottweiler mix, Daisy, for many years at her previous location, so she was our first phone call when we got Georgie.
After describing Georgie's condition, all the mats, etc, Alexis clearly communicated that she would need to shave Georgie pretty short and the reasonably priced fees associated with the services we requested. We felt very comfortable leaving Georgie at the "salon" and returned an hour later to pick her up. I can tell you that I cried when I saw Georgie happily run out from the back with a complete glow up! Total transformation. Georgie has since been groomed by Alexis a second time and we are again satisfied with the experience.
Alexis is the absolute BEST!!! She takes great care of Miss Kitty and does beautiful work on her fur & nails. Highly recommend.

Thank you so much, my babies are happy.
They had a great experience today! I loved your work. Looking forward to seeing you again!  Very professional and a beautiful  and  safe establishment. Thank you for your service

Alexis did a phenomenal job with my cat, Fig! She was easy to work with and eased all of my worries since it would be Fig’s first grooming experience. He was calm as could be when I picked him up and he looks (and smells) great! Very reasonably priced and quick service.

Will be back for his monthly nail trim and the works when he needs it next!
I’ve been taking my cat Barbara to this spot for a while now and they always take really good care of her. Highly recommend this groomer.
Alexis is by for the best, she took care of my boy for his 1st haircut today! I highly recommend Pets and the City

Alexis at Pets and the city shop was AMAZING
The place is cute and there’s fun boutique items and treats & she handled our boy with care!! Great pricing, great availability, and soooo many services available. Highly recommend, we will be regular customers here!! 10/10 not even a question!!!!!!

I’m so happy that I found this gem. Pricing is reasonable, appointments are fairly easy to obtain, and Tully always looks great after. I’d also like to add that I was prompted to get a growth on my dog’s face checked out after one of her grooming sessions. Turns out it was cancer so I’m also very thankful that she pointed out that the growth appeared to be getting bigger. I’ve recommended this groomer to many people by word of mouth and all have been happy with the service as well.
Alexis was great with our anxious dog!  He gets nervous around people, but Alexis was really good with him. Thank you Alexis!!!

One of the best groomers in the city she was very patient with my cat Mimi. She did a good job on the cleaning and grooming. also, she’s very professional. I will definitely be bringing my cat back. Also she gave my cat a free shirt
First client this past August and did a wonderful job!

I’ve been taking my boy Pablo to Alexis for almost 3 years for full service grooms — he always comes back soooo handsome!!! Alexis is extremely professional and amazing at what she does!!!!  Love the new location!! Has treats and pet outfits!!! Highly recommend you bring your pets here!
Alexis and the whole staff is great! very accommodating and the best prices around! i’ll for sure be bringing my cats back down the road and would definitely recommend pets and the city to anyone!

Very happy with our experience with Alexis! My golden retriever was nervous/skiddish but Alexis handled it great and made her feel comfortable. Her cut looks great! I will definitely use Alexis again :)
My guy Oscar has a great experience here and leaves looking so handsome & clean. He even gives happy goodbye kisses to his groomer. 🐾 …
The best

I’ve used this grooming service a few times.  Alexis has always done exactly what I wanted.  Her prices are very reasonable and services are quick, pets don’t have to sit in cages all day which I appreciate. Definitely recommend
